ir.name: loss_pairwise_exponential_advantage_gap_costgap_penalty_safe
ir.intuition: Pairwise exponential penalty using the difference in log probabilities weighted by a clamped cost gap to ensure numerical stability.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))
weight = batch.get('weight', ones)
alpha = extra.get('alpha', 1.0)
margin = lpw - lpl
abs_cost = clamp(abs(cost_gap), 0, 100)
scaled = -alpha * margin * abs_cost
loss = exp(clamp(scaled, -50, 50)) - 1
loss = loss * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    abs_cost = ops.clamp(ops.abs(cost_gap), min=0.0, max=100.0)
    scaled = ops.neg(ops.mul(alpha, ops.mul(margin, abs_cost)))
    scaled = ops.clamp(scaled, min=-50.0, max=50.0)
    loss = ops.sub(ops.exp(scaled), ops.ones_like(scaled))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
